stemAssignment.source: No CP02 assignment exists for CIN_013; lam_trieu music + mountain_wind ambience are the road-and-gate cues (composed, CP26/CP30) for this scene (S01: a stone gatehouse with a tiled roof over an open gate in a stone wall, refugees with packs and bundles passing through, baskets and bundles on the ground, mountains behind, WIDE_STATIC; S02: the refugee leader in a patched robe and headscarf, holding a folded map and raising one finger, at a village edge with thatched huts, bamboo, baskets and mountains, MEDIUM_STATIC; S03: Ly An in a blue robe with a conical hat on her back, standing at an open wooden gate looking out over rice paddies and a village road, a white ribbon tied to the gate post, MEDIUM_STATIC; keyframes CIN_013 S01/S02/S03). lam_trieu is the composed set's G-major transposition with ornamented flute ('Lam Trieu', forest tide) -- a pastoral flute voice for the village road, the paddies and the waiting line ('Chua dong cong. Con mot nguoi di sau.'); mountain_wind is the wind bed for the mountain gate, the open pass and the paddies of all three shots. tran_son ('Tran Son — Nguoi qua cua', the bell-led gate form) was passed over: it is the gate cue by name, but it was just used for CIN_012, the immediately preceding scene, and for CIN_008 -- a third use in a row would blur two consecutive scenes. bach_uyen is the underwater low-passed form (wrong setting); rift_finale is the set's only full close (finale material, wrong for a mid-campaign waiting beat); boss_mang_cot is boss material. The reveal stinger is the scene's only manifest-listed candidate stem (CIN_013_timing_v1.json).
stemAssignment.alternateTakeExcluded: N/A: CIN_013 has no alternate take.

notes: VO window 12.5-17.5 s is PROPOSED_ANIMATIC_PLACEMENT (only CIN_001_S05 is DECIDED); all 21 windows are approved for DRAFT VO per Goi 30 D1. The window is the uniform 12.5-17.5 s (37 chars at 7.40 chars/s); it was NOT widened.

VO take runs 12.5-14.972 s: 2.472 s, ending 2.528 s BEFORE the 17.5 s window end -- the take FITS inside its window by 2528 ms (no overrun, unlike CIN_005/CIN_006). The take ends 3.028 s before the 18.00 s scene end, so no tail trim at the scene edge. The window, the take and the timing are unchanged.
The CP17 VO take measures -22.51 LUFS (checkpoint 17, re-verified from real bytes this run, vs -25.38 LUFS for the CIN_012 take). VO is kept at unity per the recipe, not normalized.

Staging question (not a mix defect): the timing manifest marks the S03 dialogue onscreen: true for the refugee leader, but the S03 keyframe and the runtime clip at 15 s show only Ly An at the open gate; the leader is on screen in S02, not S03. The line therefore plays over a shot of Ly An waiting at the gate. Whether that reads as voice-over or a staging mismatch is a director/Codex call; the mix does not move the VO to hide it.

Ducking depth is measured on the ducked bus against its unducked render (RMS over the full VO window vs a 2 s reference before the window). The full-window method from checkpoint 39 is retained so the depth is comparable across the CIN_003/CIN_005/CIN_007/CIN_008/ CIN_009/CIN_010/CIN_011/CIN_012/CIN_013 mixes (a 2 s slice can understate the cut on cues whose window opening is quiet).
Ambience loop join uses a 1 s acrossfade; loopQA reports the max sample jump at the join against the bed's own 99.9th-percentile jump.
Stinger placement at 6.0 s (S02 start) is PROPOSED pending picture lock, mirroring the CIN_004 reveal at 6.0 s.
